subject: [NAME] - ML Ops
text:
Hi 
       [NAME], 

       We recently started working with Entrust (Onfido) to better understand model failure modes and tighten the loop between model drift and data fixes - especially where the margin for error is low.

       Given [COMPANY]'s focus on IDV and fraud risk, I imagine you're thinking about similar questions: spotting where models break, improving training data representativeness, and reducing false positives as edge cases evolve. 

       Encord helps IDV teams operationalize that feedback loop across data curation, labeling, HITL QA, and model eval in regulated environments. 

       If this is something you're actively working on, let's put 20 min on the calendar and see if we're solving adjacent problems. I'm pretty flexible Tue - Thu - should I send a couple of times?

subject: [NAME] - computer vision
text:
Hi 
       [NAME],

       Congrats on your promotion to VP of AI! I noticed you're looking at AI tool adoption. Curious - is improving labeling throughput and multimodal (image, video, audio, text) support priorities when it comes to choosing annotation tools?

       At Encord, we support video-centric CV/ML teams with curation, annotation, and model evaluation with model-assisted pre-labeling, native video rendering, automated QA and HITL review. We're working with smart camera and surveillance teams like LVT, Flock Safety, and Milestone Systems to move from point solutions like Voxel51 and CVAT to a consolidated setup that boosts throughput 6x and improves model accuracy by 30%. 

       Would you be open to a quick chat to see if we could drive similar results at Vivint? We're flexible morning times MT next week.

subject: LandingAI <> Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following LandingAI's work on agentic document extraction,
especially how you're tackling long-tail document variability with DPT-2.

I work closely with teams building production document AI systems, and a
common theme we're seeing is what happens after models went into
production: reviewing extraction failures, adjudicating edge cases, and
turning real-world errors into systematic procut and model improvements.

Would love to grab 20 mins to compare notes and see if any resonate as you
evaluate and iterate ADE as usage scales - Would next Thu / Fri work for
you for a quick chat?
